purpose: Present a bad final outcome after an unfortunate course of events.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
give explain a reason cause result
I overslept, forgot my wallet, and even ended up losing my ticket.
He is repeatedly late and now does not even come to meetings.
I tried to repair it but ended up breaking a part.
restrictions: Usually follows a series of deteriorating actions or failures.
mistake: Do not use it for a straightforward positive achievement.
